user_decision.question: The paper's BibTeX key is brastmckie2025construction but its year field reads 2026, and the paper is forthcoming. Which year should the key and the year field share?
options: Set year = {2025} to match the existing brastmckie2025construction key, keeping note = {Forthcoming} — preserves any external citations of the key
Rename the key to brastmckie2026construction and keep year = {2026} — breaks existing citations of the old key but reflects an expected 2026 publication
user_decision.recommended: Set year = {2025} to match the existing brastmckie2025construction key, keeping note = {Forthcoming} — preserves any external citations of the key
